quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: The Motorcycle Safety Foundation suggests the SEE strategy for safe riding. What does SEE mean?

options.text: Search, Evaluate, and Execute
Stop, End, and Evaluate
Scan, Error, and Energy

questions.correctAnswerText: Search, Evaluate, and Execute
questions.explanation: Good riders use the SEE strategy to ride safely. SEE stands for Search, Evaluate, and Execute.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing ahead
Yield
Reduce speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or words. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Only ride in the left portion of the lane.
Change your lane position based on road and traffic conditions.
Only ride in the right portion of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your lane position based on road and traffic conditions.
questions.explanation: No single lane position is always best. Change your lane position as road and traffic conditions change.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcycle riders?

options.text: Sneakers
Sturdy boots
Sandals

questions.correctAnswerText: Sturdy boots
questions.explanation: Leather boots offer the best foot protection. Boots should be high enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: Before riding, you should check all of the following except:

options.text: Tires
Turn signals
Paint

questions.correctAnswerText: Paint
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tires, controls, lights, signals, mirrors, brakes, oil, fluids, chassis, and stands.

questions.question: When entering a turn, when should you change gears?

options.text: Before the turn
During the turn
Take the motorcycle out of gear

questions.correctAnswerText: Before the turn
questions.explanation: Change gears before entering a turn. If you must change gears in a turn, do it smoothly.

questions.question: How important is your lane position when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It has little effect on whether other drivers see you.
It is very important because it affects whether other drivers see you.
It cannot protect you from wind blasts from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is very important because it affects whether other drivers see you.
questions.explanation: The right lane position helps other drivers see you. It also protects you from wind blasts from nearby vehicles.

questions.question: Which lane position lets a car ahead see you in its rearview mirror?

options.text: The left portion of the lane
The center portion of the lane
The right portion of the lane
No lane position allows them to see you

questions.correctAnswerText: The center portion of the lane
questions.explanation: Riding in the center of your lane puts you in the rearview mirror of the car ahead. Drivers check rearview mirrors much more than side mirrors.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what should riders do?

options.text: Keep safe following distances from each other
Follow each other as closely as possible
Not worry about distances between members

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep safe following distances from each other
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, use a staggered formation. This keeps riders close together while maintaining safe following distances.

questions.question: What material gives the best crash protection?

options.text: Denim
Leather or synthetic materials
Wool

questions.correctAnswerText: Leather or synthetic materials
questions.explanation: Leather and synthetic materials offer the best protection in a crash. Always wear long pants and a jacket when riding.

questions.question: Use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection to:

options.text: Check if drivers behind you notice you are stopping.
Watch for pedestrians ahead.
Look for dark clouds that may indicate bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check if drivers behind you notice you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly to see if drivers behind you are paying attention to you and your movements. Use your mirrors when stopping to make sure drivers behind you are responding to your stop.

questions.question: Which color clothing makes you less visible to other drivers?

options.text: Orange
Yellow
Brown

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors like orange, red, yellow, or green to be more visible to other drivers. Avoid dark or dull colors while riding.

questions.question: Keeping space between you and other vehicles helps because:

options.text: You can draft off other vehicles better.
You can stop more quickly.
You have more time to react to what other drivers do.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have more time to react to what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle at all times. If a hazard appears, you will have more time to respond and more space to move safely.

questions.question: Rider boots or shoes should:

options.text: Be below the ankles.
Cover the ankles.
Be made of soft, flexible material.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover the ankles.
questions.explanation: Choose sturdy shoes or boots that cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: Unlike other drinks, alcohol:

options.text: Goes into your bloodstream right away.
Must be digested.
Does not affect humans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Goes into your bloodstream right away.
questions.explanation: Alcohol does not need to be digested like other food and drink. It enters your bloodstream directly through your stomach and small intestine and quickly reaches your brain.

questions.question: Improper braking:

options.text: Usually has no consequences.
Is a major cause of many motorcycle crashes.
Should not be a concern since motorcycles have two brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is a major cause of many motorcycle crashes.
questions.explanation: Improper braking causes many motorcycle crashes. Using correct braking technique is important for safe riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Two-way traffic
Right lane ends
Merge

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic lanes are merging ahead.

questions.question: To avoid a collision, a motorcyclist should:

options.text: Look straight ahead only.
Not be willing to move to avoid hazards.
Look ahead 10 to 15 seconds on the road in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead 10 to 15 seconds on the road in front of you.
questions.explanation: Look ahead 10 to 15 seconds on the road in front of you to spot hazards early. This gives you time to react to hazards before you reach them.

questions.question: As your motorcycle goes faster, you will:

options.text: Need to shift up through the gears.
Need to shift down through the gears.
Need to put the motorcycle in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need to shift up through the gears.
questions.explanation: Shift into higher gears as your motorcycle speeds up.

questions.question: Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS) are designed to:

options.text: Stop wheels from locking up and sliding.
Lock up the wheels while keeping control.
Discourage braking on wet surfaces.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop wheels from locking up and sliding.
questions.explanation: Some motorcycles have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS). ABS stops wheels from sliding and locking up during hard braking. When you press both brakes hard, electronic sensors detect if a wheel is about to lock. The system then releases and reapplies brake pressure to keep the best braking power.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slippery when wet
Lanes shift
Yield

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. This sign warns drivers that the road ahead will be slippery when wet.

questions.question: When choosing a protective jacket for riding a motorcycle, you should look for one that is:

options.text: Black, or another dark color.
Warm.
Made of leather or synthetic materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: Made of leather or synthetic materials.
questions.explanation: A good protective jacket should cover your arms completely and fit snugly while allowing free movement. Leather or sturdy synthetic materials with body armor provide the best protection.

questions.question: When alcohol and drugs are used together, their effects:

options.text: Are less dangerous than when either is used alone.
Often balance out.
Can be stronger than when either is used alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be stronger than when either is used alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, can make riding unsafe. Combining drugs with alcohol can be even more dangerous.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow on a traffic signal mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
You may proceed through the intersection with caution.
You must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in the direction you want to go.

questions.question: If riding during the day, you should wear:

options.text: Brightly-colored clothing to be seen more easily.
Clothing of any color because other drivers can see you in daylight.
Darkly-colored clothing to stand out in bright sunlight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brightly-colored clothing to be seen more easily.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in broad daylight. Always wear brightly-colored clothing to increase visibility while riding, even during the day.
